summary: This video showcases a full Fire/Burn team composition facing the Season 8 endgame boss Mekkatorque during Phase 2. The team hits over 1.05 billion total damage across a 7-minute fight. The setup relies on consistent Ignite/Burn synergy, shields, and debuff cleansing/dispelling to sustain and scale damage. Detailed gear builds, stats, and ultimate skill timings are provided at the end of the run.

heroes.name: Paixton
heroes.note: Serves as the highest single damage dealer in the team, dealing over 95 million personal damage.

heroes.name: Durem
heroes.note: Contributes over 83 million direct damage alongside steady Ignite application.

heroes.name: Karf
heroes.note: Provides massive Ignite infliction and dealt over 70 million damage.

heroes.name: Journ
heroes.note: Dispels enemy buffs, decreases boss Ultimate Energy, and sustains team damage.

heroes.name: Khrysos
heroes.note: Keeps the entire party alive through high boss incoming damage with allied shields and enemy dispels.

teams.note: Achieved 1,053,546,074 damage in a 7-minute battle with auto skill timings synchronized on a 15-second recast rotation.

tips: Set all team member ultimate skill recasts to 15.0s to stay aligned with boss attack cycles.
Order initial skill releases carefully: Khrysos at 10.5s, Karf at 11.3s, Journ at 11.5s, Durem at 12.5s, and Paixton at 13.0s.
title: Burn vs Mekkatorque (Phase 2) | Endgame Boss | Season 8 | Dragonheir
